phase: E5 — historical QA of candidate B, and E6 closure
handler: cc (Opus), sole adjudicator. The worker computes and never owns criteria or verdict.

preregistration_scope_stated_honestly.what_this_is: PRE-RESULT with respect to historical outcomes only. No historical 12-month outcome was computed or read before this file was written.
preregistration_scope_stated_honestly.what_this_is_not: It is not a pre-current freeze. The 2026 output of candidate B is already known — SPX Base 6,526 and NDX Base 31,452 — and claiming otherwise would be false.
preregistration_scope_stated_honestly.consequence: Any change to a threshold or definition below, after historical outcomes are read, VOIDS the run. An unfavourable result is not a bug.

candidate_B_frozen.terminal: RI_4 = (LTROE − Ke) × B3 ; CV3 = RI_4 / (Ke − g) ; discounted three years
candidate_B_frozen.g_rule: g(t0) = Rf(t0), the contemporaneous risk-free rate at that origin. Never the 2026 rate at a historical origin.
candidate_B_frozen.stable_retention: b = g(t0) / LTROE_scenario, reported per origin and required inside [0,1]
candidate_B_frozen.grid: ERP {base−0.005, base, base+0.005} × LTROE {base−0.005, base, base+0.005}
candidate_B_frozen.BASE: the explicit base × base cell, never the statistical median of the nine

origins.not_movable: An origin is never shifted for source availability or for a better outcome.
origins.P0_convention: last trading close on or before the origin date
origins.P12_convention: target_date = origin + 12 calendar months; P12 = last trading close on or before target_date

ltroe_normalization_at_historical_origin.rule: median of the index ROE series over the trailing ten calendar years ending at the origin, after dropping non-finite values
ltroe_normalization_at_historical_origin.series_start_limitation: The benchmark ROE series begins 2010-01-01, so origins before 2020-01 cannot reach a full ten years. Where the window is short, use every observation from series start to the origin and record the actual window and observation count.
ltroe_normalization_at_historical_origin.classification_effect: A window shorter than ten years is DISCLOSED and does not by itself demote an origin, because the method is unchanged and only the sample is shorter. An origin with fewer than 60 monthly observations is demoted to RECONSTRUCTED_PIT_PROXY.

pit_classification.MODEL_EQUIVALENT_PIT: every required input knowable at the origin AND the same field semantics, source class and forecast methodology as live B
pit_classification.RECONSTRUCTED_PIT_PROXY: every input knowable at the origin, but at least one material input uses a different source class or forecast methodology than live B
pit_classification.RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY: at least one material input cannot be shown knowable at the origin
pit_classification.primary_qa_accepts: MODEL_EQUIVALENT_PIT only; proxy results are reported separately and never merged into the primary aggregates
pit_classification.the_decisive_question_named_in_advance: Live B takes FY1 from the benchmark forward-EPS anchor and the FY2/FY3 path from the constituent consensus snapshot. If the constituent snapshot is a current-only file with no historical vintages, then no historical origin can be MODEL_EQUIVALENT on the forecast leg, and READY becomes unreachable on data grounds rather than on model grounds. That distinction is the point of this classification and is written here before the inventory is run.

per_origin_metrics.direction_deadband: UP if return > +3%, DOWN if < −3%, FLAT otherwise

small_sample_discipline: With at most seven origins, no strong t-statistical claim is manufactured. Origin-level rows are reported beside every aggregate.

naive_benchmark.gate: median Base error ≤ median no-change error, for BOTH indices
naive_benchmark.no_future_information: A benchmark that uses anything unknowable at the origin is prohibited.

terminal_fragility.shadows_are_not_candidates: g1 and g2 are falsification probes. Neither may be adopted, and no new terminal family may be created if B proves fragile — B is then judged, not replaced.
terminal_fragility.g2_status: disclosure and falsification only; a flip at g2 is reported and does not by itself trigger RETIRE

known_before_outcomes: Current NDX Base terminal share is already about 79.7% and SPX about 68.5%. Recorded here rather than discovered later.

payout_materiality_gate.raw_divergence: disclosure, not a gate, when the valuation effect is immaterial

ready_gates_all_required.M2: Ke − g >= 0.03 in every canonical cell
ready_gates_all_required.M3: Base terminal share <= 0.90 at every primary origin
ready_gates_all_required.P7: SPX median Base error <= median no-change error
ready_gates_all_required.P8: NDX median Base error <= median no-change error
ready_gates_all_required.F1: SPX current 100bp g shadow does not flip valuation direction
ready_gates_all_required.F2: NDX current 100bp g shadow does not flip valuation direction

no_partial_credit: READY requires every gate. There is no weighting and no qualitative override of a failed hard gate.
research_only_conditions: READY fails with no decisive structural or historical anti-signal
the historical test uses materially different forecast or source semantics
terminal fragility too high for a public-grade target while current numbers stay interpretable
research_only_is_a_closure_state: It is not an instruction to invent another model.

structural: repeated Ke <= g or pole instability
monotonicity still broken after a genuine bug repair
target-fitting necessary to make output usable
retire_conditions.historical_anti_signal_A: BOTH indices: median Base error > median no-change error AND direction hit < 0.50 AND Spearman <= 0
retire_conditions.historical_anti_signal_B: BOTH indices: band hit < 0.40 while median band width <= 0.40

live_rebase.when: after E5 and after the verdict computation, never before
allowed_to_change: ERP if a newer officially available observation exists
EPS/PB/ROE/payout if the same existing ingestion contract has a newer release
two_views_both_reported: LIVE_REBASE — same formula, freshest mutually aligned inputs
live_rebase.source_clock_sensitivity_flag: raised if Base moves more than 5% on a small source-date update, with the driver named
live_rebase.headline: the final owner headline uses LIVE_REBASE with the validation snapshot beside it

prohibitions: no parameter changed to fit current or historical price
no origin moved to improve availability or outcome
no 2026 consensus backfilled to a historical origin
no restated accounting value treated as knowable at the origin
no band widened to raise hit rate
no threshold moved after outcomes are read
no new terminal or RIM family if B proves weak — B is judged
no MORE_RESEARCH_NEEDED, NEEDS_MORE_WORK or NEXT_MODEL_VERSION verdict
no public promotion; quarantine holds until separate owner approval
no editing of this file; supersede with -v2 carrying an explicit same-meaning statement

bug_repair_protocol.allowed: If a genuine implementation or data bug is found: preserve the prior run as VOID, leave every threshold and assumption untouched, fix only the bug, keep the same criteria hash or freeze an explicitly same-meaning v2, and recompute every affected part.

verification_protocol.worker: computes, then re-derives by a structurally different route and states what it would not defend
verification_protocol.handler: independently re-derives at least two origins end to end with separate code, and never by importing the worker's scoring or result artifact
